purpose: Turn the verified Reset Discord studio channel into a controlled remote production entry point for a dedicated OBS scene and Community DAW workflow without changing live routing until tested.

discord.webhook_rule: Create only for approved outbound studio automation. Never expose webhook URLs in browser code or public config.

obs.future_scene: Reset Inner Circle Community DAW - Virtual Studio

restream.rule: Do not reconnect or broadcast automatically. Re-authentication is an owner action and must occur only during a supervised production test.

community_daw.project_name: Reset Inner Circle Community DAW - Discord.xpj

target_signal_flow: Optional supervised live broadcast through approved Restream destinations

worker_assignment.ROWAN: orchestration, dependency order, safety gates, Founder escalation
worker_assignment.FORGE: OBS scene engineering, source validation, recording reliability, rollback profile
worker_assignment.SIGNAL: approved live-event packaging, promotion routing, audience/discovery activation
worker_assignment.CARE: participant onboarding, consent clarity, guest experience, support recovery
worker_assignment.PULSE: service/revenue attribution only after approved paid studio offers are active; never count sessions as revenue before payment
worker_assignment.ATLAS: education/workshop use cases and creator training documentation
worker_assignment.LEDGER: rights/provenance guard when recorded music, stems, performances, or licensed material enter a session

execution_phases.name: Inventory and backup
steps: Export/backup current OBS profile and Luxury INNER Circle scene collection
Record current Wave Link routing and monitoring state
Do not modify existing working broadcast scenes

execution_phases.name: Dedicated scene build
steps: Create Reset Inner Circle Community DAW - Virtual Studio scene
Add isolated host, guest, DAW and branding sources
Create technical hold / BRB fallback
Keep Restream disconnected during engineering

execution_phases.name: Audio isolation
steps: Separate Discord guest, host mic, DAW and monitor buses in Wave Link
Prevent monitor echo and Discord feedback
Verify OBS receives intended buses exactly once

execution_phases.name: Consent and scheduling automation
steps: Use Discord studio channel as the session entry point
Add approved session request / consent / preflight workflow
Send normalized session-state metadata to AOS only after CreatorHub ingress certification

execution_phases.name: Local QA
steps: Run private two-person Discord test
Record locally without streaming
Verify lip sync, audio isolation, DAW capture, no feedback, fallback scene, and file integrity

execution_phases.name: Supervised broadcast certification
steps: Owner reconnects Restream if desired
Test one approved destination first
Verify destination health before multi-platform expansion
Never auto-start a broadcast

dependencies: CreatorHub communications/intelligence ingress certification before AOS session relay
verified Discord permissions for studio channel
Founder-approved Restream reconnection before any live broadcast
